lines.t:
An <c:ffff00>act<c> that returns a <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c> in <c:ffff00>{{medachange_form}}<c>
to its original state. The higher the <c:ffff00>{{medal_level}}<c>, the
faster <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> are.
It can be used at any time; in addition, if the <c:ffff00>Charge<c>
<c:ffff00>Gauge<c> falls below 10% in {{medachange_form}}, it is
forcibly reverted.
When reverting, the <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c> is split evenly among the
4 <c:ffff00>slots<c> and all <c:ffff00>negative statuses<c> disappear.
